name: C001
intent: Original editorial poster for a reusable bottle named STILL.

criteria.requirement: Headline reads exactly A quieter everyday. and the bottle label reads STILL. No other words or logos.
Exactly one reusable bottle, with legible headline and generous margins.
An asymmetrical layout: two-line headline at middle left, large bottle at right, generous space above.
Soft natural window light from the upper left; a realistic grounded shadow and subtle tactile surface.
Powder blue bottle, warm off-white background, charcoal text, and one restrained blue accent.
Photorealistic studio product photography with editorial typography.
Bold clean sans-serif headline; brand label in small spaced uppercase. Font identity is unspecified.
